description_excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE DHL Global Forwarding Vietnam is seeking a Pricing & Solutions Assistant Manager (Customs Brokerage & Trucking) to drive the continued growth and service excellence of our Value-Added Services (VAS) - spanning customs brokerage, domestic trucking, and related logistics solutions across Vietnam. Sitting within the Pricing team, this role combines daily service delivery management with strategic vendor development, solution design, and market intelligence to elevate the overall value we deliver to customers.
